assertions.description: The page is the checkout confirmation surface, so the order was placed rather than left on the overview
The confirmation message is shown, which only appears after Finish succeeds
The confirmation page's own control is present, distinguishing a real completed order from a stale or partial render

That the single ordered line item is the lowest-priced product in the catalog, in quantity 1, cannot be checked from the confirmation page: it lists no line item, and the catalog prices are live and can change between runs. Verify the selection on the Checkout: Overview page (one row, QTY 1, unit price equal to the cheapest card price read on the Products page) before clicking Finish.

That checkout was completed with the task's supplied customer name and postal code cannot be checked from the confirmation page: it restates neither field. Verify the typed values on the Checkout: Your Information form and the shipping summary on Checkout: Overview before continuing.
